title: My ribbon wasn’t on a continuous roll
text: My ribbon wasn’t on a continuous roll. The description didn’t state that this gnome ribbon was not on a continuous roll. It was taped in two separate places with double sided sticky tape. $14.99 plus tax, you’d think the product would be top notch. Wasn’t able to make the large bows for the project I’m working on!

product_metadata.title: Wired Ribbon Christmas Gnomes with Snowdrift Fringe for Wreaths, Floral Arrangements, Gift Wrapping, Crafting (Light Natural, 2.5)
